description: This file defines an abstract base class 'DeviceAdapter' that provides a common interface for various device types (hardware, simulator, QEMU) used in testing environments. It includes methods for device control, output handling, and logging, and references specific exceptions and configuration classes from the 'twister_harness' package.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for device interaction in testing, including methods for launching, connecting, disconnecting, reading output, and managing device state.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the device adapter with device configuration, setting up internal queues, threads, and log paths.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Starts the device, flashes and runs the application if needed, and starts the output reader thread.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Disconnects and stops the device and reader thread.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the device for output gathering.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the device, stopping output collection.

methods.name: readline
methods.description: Reads a line of output from the device with optional timeout and output printing.

methods.name: readlines_until
methods.description: Reads multiple lines until a regex match, a number of lines, or timeout occurs.

methods.name: readlines
methods.description: Reads all available output lines from the device.

methods.name: clear_buffer
methods.description: Clears the internal output buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the device.

methods.name: initialize_log_files
methods.description: Initializes log files with test start information.

methods.name: _start_reader_thread
methods.description: Starts a background thread to handle device output.

methods.name: _handle_device_output
methods.description: Background thread method to read device output and log it.

methods.name: _read_from_queue
methods.description: Reads data from internal queue with timeout.

methods.name: _join_reader_thread
methods.description: Joins the output reader thread.

methods.name: _clear_internal_resources
methods.description: Resets internal resources and state.

methods.name: west
methods.description: Property that returns the path to 'west' tool, raising an exception if not found.

methods.name: generate_command
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the command for device operation.

methods.name: _flash_and_run
methods.description: Abstract method to flash and run application on device.

methods.name: _connect_device
methods.description: Abstract method to connect to the device.

methods.name: _disconnect_device
methods.description: Abstract method to disconnect from the device.

methods.name: _close_device
methods.description: Abstract method to stop device application.

methods.name: _read_device_output
methods.description: Abstract method to read raw output bytes from device.

methods.name: _write_to_device
methods.description: Abstract method to write bytes to device.

methods.name: _flush_device_output
methods.description: Abstract method to flush device output buffer.

methods.name: is_device_running
methods.description: Abstract method to check if device application is running.

methods.name: is_device_connected
methods.description: Abstract method to check if device is connected.
